comment: Both oscillators take the same FM jack, Osc2.cpp:111-124, so frequency modulation moves them together. The Phs jack is mapped from -5V to 5V onto the whole of a cycle before the CV knob is applied, Osc2.cpp:134-137. Oversampling is off when the module is placed, unlike the other alias-suppressed oscillators in the plugin, and is the menu's only setting.
